fusions.name: Over the Rim
fusions.desc: Hooks the target's guard down with the beard of the blade, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bash and Hew
fusions.desc: Shoves forward behind your guard through a short cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and stunning each one for 1 second.

fusions.name: Edge Behind the Guard
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Answer the Blow
fusions.desc: When you are hurt, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
